purpose: Fix one fail-closed, dependency-free, deterministic serialization and digest contract for every later distillation schema, including canonical JSON, content-derived IDs, logical versus physical digests, canonical ZIP/NPZ bytes, and raw versus canonical trajectory digest separation, without defining the PH-D02B domain schemas or entering causal work.

X.coordinate: Common representation layer after source and replay-environment identity freeze and before the thirty-eight domain schemas, HDS state records, approvals, Typed Causal IR, or trajectory normalization
inputs: PH-D01B frozen source, acquisition, environment, and run manifest metadata
HDS distillation specification section 7 canonical serialization and digest contract
PH-D02A roadmap implementation list, DG-06, DG-07, and DoD
synthetic canonical JSON, ZIP, NPZ, and trajectory fixtures
X.change_scope: PH-D02A canonical contract, pure deterministic codec, synthetic test vectors, conformance report, tests, phase evidence, and isolated distillation documentation only.

R.risk: Implicit Unicode forms, unordered iteration, floating non-finite values, self-referential fields, filesystem metadata, host paths, ZIP metadata, compression-library drift, tensor byte order, or ambiguous raw/canonical trajectory hashes would make later evidence non-reproducible or falsely interchangeable.
R.required_response: Fail closed on unsupported values, non-string or NFC-colliding keys, invalid confidence fields, NaN or infinity, ambiguous unordered paths, invalid repository/archive paths, duplicate normalized members, unsupported dtype, native-endian ambiguity, shape/value mismatch, non-finite tensor values, self-referential digest input, or physical package drift.
R.claim_boundary: PH_D02A_CANONICAL_CONTRACT_PASS may establish only deterministic representation and digest behavior on the declared contract and test vectors. It does not establish the PH-D02B schemas, executable Causal IR, trajectory normalization, exact-fit causal support, Rule promotion, Bridge readiness, AGI capability, or official readiness.

Mc.mechanism: Recursive Unicode NFC normalization; strict JSON-domain typing; explicit unordered-array JSON pointers and sorted set normalization; integer confidence_ppm validation; explicit top-level digest-exclusion policy; domain-separated SHA-256 IDs and logical, physical, raw-trajectory, and canonical-trajectory digests; ZIP_STORED archives with normalized names, fixed metadata, and lexical member order; dependency-free NPY v1 tensor encoding with fixed dtype, little endian, C order, shape, and header alignment; and committed synthetic vectors rebuilt in independent processes.
Mc.owner_authority: 大平鉄兵 remains the sole Rule, promotion, bundle, locked-final, official, and submission decision authority.
Mc.rollback: Revert PH-D02A-owned commits only; preserve PH-D01A/B frozen artifacts, all source bytes, external archives, pre-existing P22/CV worktree changes, and prior phase evidence.
